Messages.Author: Instantiation
Messages.Body:
Ok, we're (my play group and myself) are confused. I've read multiple
threads regarding the new allies-torpor thing, but I'm still not sure.
Please spell it out for us (because one person says one thing, and
another says another, and we've got some people who just aren't sure
of what the heck is going on.)

Rafastio plays burst of sunlight...

She's either a) treated as a vampire, burns the life for the
aggravated damage, tries to go to torpor because she's acting as a
vampire but can't because she's *really* an ally, and instead burns.

or b) treated as a vampire, and burns the life for the aggravated
damage, but because she *only* burns the life for the damage she does
not go to torpor, and hence does not burn (unless she takes damage
from someone else hitting her or whatever, that's inconsequential to
my question, really).

Please be kind and just lay it out.

Instantiation of Absurdity
Salubri Primogen of Northgate (Seattle)

Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:
Instantiation wrote:
> Ok, we're (my play group and myself) are confused. I've read multiple
> threads regarding the new allies-torpor thing, but I'm still not sure.
> Please spell it out for us (because one person says one thing, and
> another says another, and we've got some people who just aren't sure
> of what the heck is going on.)
>
> Rafastio plays burst of sunlight...
>
> She's either a) treated as a vampire, burns the life for the
> aggravated damage, tries to go to torpor because she's acting as a
> vampire but can't because she's *really* an ally, and instead burns.
>
> or b) treated as a vampire, and burns the life for the aggravated
> damage, but because she *only* burns the life for the damage she does
> not go to torpor, and hence does not burn (unless she takes damage
> from someone else hitting her or whatever, that's inconsequential to
> my question, really).

b)

But more exactly, she's treated as a vampire and so takes the agg
damage, but since she's really an ally the agg. damage doesn't send her
to torpor during the 'heal damage' phase, she burns one life for it instead.

Flux
